tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg --help 2>&1; echo "===LIST==="; hops fg list 2>&1 | head -30

tool_input.command: hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command: hops fg create customers38e0c1 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string:unique record key,name:string,balance_eur:double:balance in EUR,updated_at:bigint:epoch millis event time" --description "Customers initial export v1" 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"
hops fg insert customers38e0c1 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"

hops fg create customers38e0c1 --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --online --features "row_id:string:unique record key,full_name:string:replaces name,balance:double:balance currency varies,currency:string:ISO code,updated_at:bigint:epoch millis event time" --description "Customers full reload v2 new schema, online enabled" 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"
